about_the_game:
The Truth Is a Dangerous, Unforgiving Thing.

Lost Traces: Genesis is the full, commercial continuation of the psychic horror saga, picking up immediately after the chilling events of the False Awakening Demo. Step into the shoes of Evelyn Strom as her personal descent into a family nightmare escalates into a global conspiracy against the mysterious organizations and the ultimate secret of her GENESIS.

Experience a story-rich, first-person psychological horror game built for the next generation of tension and fear.

🌌 Unveiling the Full Saga

If the demo was a glimpse, Genesis is the full chronicle. Prepare for a significantly expanded narrative that delves into the origins and consequences of the conspiracy:

  • Hours of Deep Lore: Piece together a complex mystery through fully voice-acted dialogue, detailed documents, and environmental storytelling that weaves together a tapestry of psychic power and inherited trauma.

  • Consequence of Choice: Every action taken in your investigation brings you closer to a terrifying truth, influencing the narrative as you face down the entity that haunts Evelyn and the conspirators who control the island.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5.4

  • Next-Gen Atmosphere: Built on the stability and visual power of UE 5.4, we deliver dramatically enhanced volumetric lighting, deeper shadows, and hyper-realistic environments that create unparalleled tension.

Survival & Investigation

  • Evolved Psychic Toolkit: Evelyn’s unique psychic powers are your most vital tool. Use them to see into the past, reveal hidden paths, and solve complex environmental puzzles that bridge the gap between two realities.

  • Classic Adventure Horror Experience: Gameplay emphasizes exploration and Investigation. Track key documents, manage resources, and master the art of searching and investigating.

⚠️ Content & Genre Tags

Lost Traces: Genesis is an intense, mature psychological horror experience. Players should expect the following content:

  • Genre: Psychological Horror, Survival Horror, Story Rich, Exploration, Conspiracy.

  • Content: Strong language, intense fear, depictions of violence and blood (non-combat), mature themes, and unsettling atmosphere.

⭐ Wishlist Now & Stay Connected

Lost Traces: Genesis is currently deep in development. Wishlisting the game is the single most important way to support us and ensures you receive the latest updates, trailers, and the official launch date announcement!

Join the community discussion and share your excitement!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) / Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 580 / GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Medium 1080p @ 45 FPS, DX12, Ray Tracing OFF ・Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes. ・ (subject to change)
